text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki captivated the audience at the 
Yayoi Sho as well. Expectations for her to 
achieve the Classic Triple Crown continue 
to grow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She trains rigorously to live up to those 
voices. Deeply moved by her dedication, 
her Trainer plans a surprise to show 
appreciation for her hard work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to present an "étoile," the 
Trainer performs a magic trick to turn the 
evening star into a star-shaped brooch. 
However, the trick ends in failure...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Fuji Kiseki's heart grew warm. 
The Satsuki Sho is finally next—
